		JOIN [dbo].[HistorialCreditoPorHora] 
			ON [HistorialCreditoPorHora].[Id] = filter.[HistorialCreditoPorHora_Id]

		ON [dbo].[HistorialCreditoPorHora].[Membresia_Id] = [dbo].[Membresia].[Id]
